note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 9687 Section 4.3 Event 29 ('If the SendHoldTimer_Expires (Event 29) occurs, the local system: ... - releases all BGP resources,'). Verified session_write.go::sendHoldTimerExpired stops SendHoldTimer, triggers FSM teardown, closes TCP connection, and returns ErrSendHoldTimerExpired so Run stops all timers and reactor peer-down purges RIB storage. Positives assert HoldTimer, KeepaliveTimer, ConnectRetryTimer, SendHoldTimer stopped and TCP conn nil (TestRFC9687Event29ReleasesHoldTimerAndConnection, TestRFC9687SendHoldExpiryRunsTheEvent29ActionList), plus live peer RIB storage and two received wire routes purged in running bgp-rib plugin (TestRFC9687Event29ReleasesTheLivePeersRIB). Negatives assert 1ns short of SendHoldTime all timers remain running, TCP conn stays held, and session stays Established (TestRFC9687Event29ReleasesHoldTimerAndConnection#2, TestRFC9687NoSendHoldExpiryLeavesTheSessionIntact). Q1-Q4 pass.
